units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 28:40">Targ. Y. Deut. XXVIII, 40</cite> <he>תטושון</he> Ar. (ed. <he>תשוטון</he>, corr. acc. or <he>תשועון</he>, v. <cite ref="U00475"><he>שׁוּע</he></cite>) you will oint yourselves.
Targ. Y. II, Lev. XIV, 42 ויטשון (read וִיטוּשׁוּן) shall plaster over; (Targ. Y. I ויִתְטַשׁ Ithpa.).—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite>, end <he>וטָשִׁין מותיה</he> (not <he>וטושין</he>) and paste the plaster on its scull.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 14:43">Targ. Y. Lev. XIV, 43</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 14:48">48</cite>; v. supra.

senses.gloss: to smear over, to make muddy. Part. pass. מְטַשְׁטַשׁ; v. infra.
to be smeared over, to be made muddy.
